notes.title: Now in 5 Languages and with better Light Gun support!
notes.content:
Hi, guys!

[h1]The Updates[/h1]
[h2]Light Gun Support[/h2]
We're releasing a new update based on your feedback! There's an extra option now where the crosshair will be invisible, so it will look even more like the classic on-rails shooters!

[h2]New Languages[/h2]
We also translated the interface and steam page to 3 new languages (and variations), so now we're supporting:
[olist]
[*] English
[*] Brazillian Portuguese
[*] Japanese
[*] Chinese - Traditional
[*] Chinese - Simplified
[*] Spanish - Lat. America
[*] Spanish - Spain
[/olist]

We hope you guys enjoy these updates!

[h1]Also checkout our new Typing game![/h1]
[h2]Tybot Invasion: Runner + Typing[/h2]

notes.title: Quick Update: Heads being highlighted
notes.content:
[h1]Quick Update[/h1]
Now the enemy's head will be highlighted on mouse hover! We hope it makes it easier for players to understand when the aim is at the head! :)

[h1]Bonus Change[/h1]
Changed some sneaky yellow queens that were appearing too close to the King, it felt too unfair so we decided to make them appear more distant :)


Hope you guys have fun! <3 <3 <3
